label: How a long job keeps going, retries, and stops without losing what it made

params.name: stop_when_left_usd
params.label: Stop before a paid step would leave less than this in the budget

params.name: max_retries
params.label: Tries again after a step fails, before the job stops

params.name: keep_days
params.label: Days a finished or stopped job's record is kept

description_nl: A long job (every narrated line of a video; later every shot of a film) is a list of steps written to disk one by one. A failed step is tried again max_retries times, retry_wait_s apart. Before a PAID step the job checks the budget: if doing it would leave less than stop_when_left_usd, it stops cleanly instead, keeps everything it made, and says what the rest would cost. Pressing the same button again carries on from the first step not done.
weight_basis: Platform operations primitive, no business content. The knobs ARE the policy - edit them here, never in Python.
